# ui::ScalarTransition

Header: `winui/ui/Animation.hpp`.

Animates every change to an element's opacity or rotation ([Element::set_opacity_transition()](element.md#set_opacity_transition), [Element::set_rotation_transition()](element.md#set_rotation_transition)) over `duration` along the cubic Bézier (0.8,0)-(0.2,1), from wherever the property is drawn at that moment.

Example: 
```cpp
auto element = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
element->set_opacity_transition(ui::ScalarTransition{.duration = 200ms});
element->set_opacity(0.0f); // fades out over 200 ms instead of vanishing
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `Duration` | `{300.0}` | Length of each transition. |
